caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent bottle with a light blue-green tint, displayed against a plain, off-white background. The bottle has a broad, rounded base that tapers upwards into a long, narrow neck with a slightly flared, angled rim. The surface of the bottle features an embossed design on the front, consisting of a central sheaf of wheat or similar plant, with leaves or fronds extending outward on both sides. The glass appears smooth and slightly reflective, with shading and highlights used to convey its translucent quality. The artwork is signed "L.S. Makinson K.C., MO." in the lower right corner. There are no other objects in the composition.
title: Bottle
